title: Elemental Workshop IV
start: Search the bookcase on the floor 1 of the Sorcerer's Tower.

items.t: About 5 each of water, earth, air and fire runes. (Only 1 of each will be used in the final riddle)
A knife (knife on your tool belt won't work; can be obtained during quest)
2 pieces of elemental ore to complete the quest, or 7 if you want the full chaos equipment set (obtainable during the quest)
8 pieces of coal (or 28 for the full set of chaos equipment; must be carried and cannot be noted or stored in an ore box)

recommended.t: Super restores to help replenish drained Runecrafting and Thieving stats (necessary if making multiple set pieces, or if you have low runecrafting)

rewards.t: Ability to make and equip elemental cosmic equipment, and chaos equipment.
Ability to make boots and gloves from all known elemental metals.

steps.t: Search the north bookcase on the floor 1 of the Sorcerer's Tower to find a notched book. [Chat: accept]
Read the book completely. (8 pages).
Pick up the knife on the ground next to you in the Sorcerer's Tower then head to the anvil near the bank in Seers' Village.
Use a knife on the whetstone in the building of the Elemental Workshop, west of the bank, to receive a keyblade.
Head down into the workshop.
Make 2 primed bars in the same way you did in the previous Elemental Workshop quests.

sub.t: Optional: Make 5 more if you want a full set.

steps.t: Head to the basement.
Use the keyblade on the southern door.
p: Da-Vi the automaton under the cosmic draining machine

steps.t: Head through the door and east to the pillar room via the cosmic door (dismiss any followers).
Solve the first puzzle (solution pictured below).

sub.t: Place the runes into the correct emitter locations.
Operate the control panel south-east.
Rotate the pillars using the controls interface (bottom right).
Pressing the circle on the control interface grid rotates the pillar. They have to match with the picture shown below.
Press "Power Up".

steps.t: Solve the second and third puzzles.

sub.t: Adjust the height of the emitters using the same control panel.

steps.t: Operate the draining machine in the south-east corner of the room.
After the cutscene, use a primed bar on the Machine directly south of the control panel.
Correct the pillar that has changed position.
Power up the control panel again.
Operate the draining machine.

sub.t: Note: you might need to drink a dose of restoration potion (operating this machine drains your Runecrafting level).

steps.t: Take the cosmic bar.
Head upstairs to the workbench to make cosmic gloves. You can log out and log back in to quickly be placed back in the first room of the Elemental Workshop.
Head back downstairs into the newly-opened chaos room.
Take the shabby book from the table in the north-west corner. Read it and keep it in your inventory during the quest.
Operate the CPU (using the 6 levers) and input the following commands in order:

sub.t: Get + Nature (Automaton should grab cube from shelf)
Put + Mind (this puts whatever he is holding onto the machine)
Get + Cosmic
Put + Mind
Break + Law (Automaton breaks down wall to blank tokens)
Get + Fire (Automaton picks up a blank token)
Put + Water (Automaton put a blank token on the workbench)

steps.t: Go to the workbench and carve the token.
Take the new astral token and use it on the broken astral token to replace it.
Return to the levers and continue with commands:

sub.t: Get + Body
Put + Mind (Automaton puts the cube with the astral rune on it onto the conveyor belt)
Get + Astral
Put + Mind
Break + Earth (Automaton breaks the second wall, then turn the chaos machine on)
Operate + Chaos (Automaton turns the chaos machine on)

steps.t: Equip your cosmic gloves.
Use a primed bar on the machine, in the room with the Automaton.
Operate the draining machine (drains Thieving level).

sub.t: Requires level 39 Thieving. Use Super restore if needed.
If it says "machine unpowered" input "Operate + Chaos" again then try again.

steps.t: Take the chaos bar.

sub.t: Optional: repeat the last 3 steps for each primed bar if you want to make more chaos pieces for the Whoa, Double Chaos achievement.

steps.t: Head upstairs to a workbench to make chaos boots. Lobbying will automatically put you right next to the anvil.
Quest complete!
